podcast.body: This song is still frequently used at sporting events to induce crowd participation, specifically encouraging audiences to shout "hey." "Our rock and roll part two by Gary Glitter, which is still used to induce the crowd to shout, hey."

srcs.episode: Ep. 36 - Na Na Na Na, Hey Hey Hey! 70s Music and Sports

podcast.body: This song was famously sampled in "Doctorin' the Tardis" by The KLF (as The Timelords) in 1988. "Dr. In The Tartus, which takes Delia Derbyshire's version of the Dr. Who theme and melds it with Gary Glitter's Rock and Roll Part 2."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song was used by The Timelords for their Doctor Who themed hit. "The Timelords, who released a Doctor Who themed hit that made the use of the Gary Glitter song Rock and Roll Part 2."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
